answer: With a Phone SIM bound by one-time code delivery with one identity per channel, the account is only as strong as its binding: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The design treats each channel as a lagoon: small alone, decisive in aggregate. Whether the proof comes from a lotus or a yarrow, the verification step is identical and public.
